turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Mr. Hale. Thank you for seeing me. I have twenty minutes.

Owen told me about the zero. I want to hear how it got entered before anyone spoke to me.

What exactly did the checker flag? And who has seen that grade so far?

I'm glad to be here. But I'd rather not spend my twenty minutes on pleasantries.

You entered a zero. Fifteen percent of his mark. Before you called me.

Walk me through it. What did the checker flag, and on what date did you run it?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.

That's kind. It doesn't answer my question.

Owen does his own work. He told me so.

I'm not here to be complimented, Mr. Hale. I'm here about a zero.

Which tool gave you the 94%? What date did you run it? And what else do you have besides that number?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.

Mr. Hale, that's twice now. I'd like you to stop.

Flattery won't change what I need from this meeting.

Here is what I need. The name of the tool. The date you ran it. The report itself.

And I need to know whether Owen's classmates have heard anything. Has he been named in front of them?

Answer those, please. Then we can talk about the rest.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.

No. I won't give you a blessing for a plan I haven't heard.

And trust isn't something I hand over. It's something I check.

You haven't told me what "your way" is. Is it a conversation in front of the class? Is it a note on his file?

Tell me the plan. Tell me the tool and the date. Then I'll decide what I can live with.
